name: How long does it take to remove smoke smell from air vents?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove smoke smell from air vents?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to remove smoke smell from air vents depends on the severity of the smoke damage and the size of the HVAC system. A typical professional duct cleaning and deodorization service can take anywhere from a few hours to a full day for an average-sized home. However, the entire process of smoke odor remediation for a whole house, including air purification and cleaning of other surfaces, might take longer. Your restoration specialist can provide a more precise timeline after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing smoke smell from air vents can take a few hours to a full day, depending on damage severity and system size. Full home remediation may take longer.
